title: Patrick Hayden & Gemini 4 Argon Prove Thermal and Perturbative Stability for 3D Passive Quantum Memory
aiSystem: Google Gemini 4 Argon & Carbon (+ Partial Lean 4 Certificates)
whyItMatters: Stanford physicist Patrick Hayden and Gemini 4 Argon—which performed most of the detailed proof construction—proved thermal self-correction below Tc > 0 and zero-temperature perturbative stability for a 3D passive quantum memory family.
summary: Posted to arXiv on November 16, 2026 (arXiv:2611.21749) by Patrick Hayden (Stanford University) with an explicit disclosure that Google’s Gemini 4 Argon performed 'most of the detailed mathematical reasoning and proof construction', this work tackles one of quantum physics’ most celebrated open challenges: whether a local 3D quantum system can passively protect a qubit against thermal noise and Hamiltonian imperfections like a classical ferromagnet protects a bit. Modifying a three-layer welded stabilizer hierarchy, Part I proves (1) unperturbed thermal self-correction with stretched-exponential memory lifetime below a positive critical temperature Tc > 0 under Markovian Davies baths, and (2) zero-temperature stability with a uniform bulk spectral gap and superpolynomially long dressed logical memory under weak superpolynomially decaying perturbations—accompanied by author-reported Lean 4 certificates of standalone existence theorems.
technicalHighlights: Establishes a three-layer welded 3D code hierarchy proving unperturbed thermal self-correction below Tc > 0 and zero-temperature perturbative stability via relaxed Bravyi–Hastings–Michalakis local topological order.
Gemini 4 Argon executed most of the detailed operator-algebraic, Lieb–Robinson, and multiscale spectral-gap proof construction under Hayden’s strategic direction.
Includes standalone Lean 4 existential verification certificates for key existence conclusions (with joint T > 0, V ≠ 0 stability deferred to a planned Part II).
caveats: Part I proves thermal stability (V = 0, T > 0) and perturbative stability (T = 0, V ≠ 0) separately—not simultaneously—with strictly asymptotic, non-physical constants (Tc ≲ 10⁻⁵¹); independent expert review of the preprint and partial Lean certificates is ongoing.

scoreRationale.foundational: Makes substantial technical progress on the long-standing 3D passive self-correcting quantum memory problem shortly after Haah’s cubic code was shown to thermalize.
scoreRationale.ripple: Demonstrates frontier AI executing deep, multi-section mathematical-physics proofs in topological quantum matter and fault-tolerant memory theory.
scoreRationale.verification: Early preprint with partial standalone Lean 4 certificates (not line-by-line formalization) currently awaiting independent expert audit and companion Part II.
scoreRationale.velocity: Gemini 4 Argon constructed intricate multiscale homological and operator-algebraic proofs that typically take research groups years.
